title: Incredible experience....
text: Incredible experience. The Flamenco show was so unique and not at all what I was expecting. Our guide did a great job of customizing the food portion of the tour to our group.
author: Christopher_R

title: Yannat tours are unsurpassed
text:
Our experience with Yannat tours was par none.  I worked directly with Matias who helped arrange our tailor made tours of Seville, Cordoba, and Granada. His recommendations were excellent and communication was always clear, concise and timely. 

In Seville, we were escorted by Mila to Flamenco and then Tapas. She graciously shared her knowledge of Flamenco dance and the rich history of Seville. The evening was an incredible experience that we’ll always treasure in large part due to our hostess and tour guide Mila.
author: dianesG8408UC

title: Excellent night of Authentic Flamenco and tapas!
text: Mila was an excellent guide, so warm and friendly right from our meeting location!  Mila shared great details about the history and culture of flamenco, the Triana neighborhood and Seville overall.  The Flamenco show itself was excellent, too talented and entertainment .  Very authentic.  The tapas dinner and restaurant were  great too off to the night.  Thank you Mila!!

title: Perfect Evening!
text: Perfect evening in Seville! Elena was delightful and incredibly knowledgeable - she made the experience so much more memorable. Amazing flamenco and tapas and wine!

title: Verry Happy

title: Fantastic Flamenco!
text: This is a great trip. You get to see an amazing and authentic show plus hear so much about the history of the dance. Mila was so enthusiatic and knowledgeable - it just made it a special night
author: Dominic_M

title: My Seville Highlight!
text: Walking from the Cathedral to Triana, our guide Mila told us history, geography and culture all along the way. She brought us to exceptional flamenco a tourist wouldn’t find. It was a high quality, exceptional show. Afterwards, Mila knew just the spot for tapas and helped us to experiment. We enjoyed it all —the show, the food, and Mila’s great company! Let her show you her Sevilla.
author: bobkenley

title: A must do
text: We had a very nice private tour with Maria, she gave us the wonderful history of flamenco and the local tapas were delicious.
